clean_source_blocks.text: Police say a man charged security outside of the dining room and was armed with multiple weapons.
Chief US correspondent Gary O'Donoghue was at the dinner and describes the scene in the room after the gunshots were heard.
US President Donald Trump was rushed to safety from the White House Correspondents' Dinner after gunshots rang out at the venue.
The suspect was accused of purse-snatching and has been charged with larceny and providing false information.

packet.source_text:
Police say a man charged security outside of the dining room and was armed with multiple weapons.

Chief US correspondent Gary O'Donoghue was at the dinner and describes the scene in the room after the gunshots were heard.

US President Donald Trump was rushed to safety from the White House Correspondents' Dinner after gunshots rang out at the venue.

The suspect was accused of purse-snatching and has been charged with larceny and providing false information.
packet.editor_brief: Kirjoita tästä yksi julkaistava, luonnollinen suomenkielinen uutisartikkeli. Älä toista lähdetekstiä, älä vuoda lähdelabelia, älä jätä englanninkielisiä otsikkoja tai kappaleita.
